usedFor: Shopify holds products and orders, and TeamGantt receives a task or milestone through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in TeamGantt
bestTemplate.why: A new product brings work, and the action adds a task or milestone to a chosen project.

watchOut: “Update Task” in TeamGantt updates an existing task, so it needs a task from an earlier step to target.
